name: ICH E6(R3) – Good Clinical Practice
summary: Principles for ethical and scientifically sound clinical trials in humans, covering responsibilities of sponsors, investigators and oversight bodies.
applies_if: There is prospective research involving human participants to generate clinical data.
example_use: Phase 2 trial for an oncology biologic conducted in multiple countries.

name: ICH Q9(R1) – Quality Risk Management
summary: Approach for identifying, assessing and controlling risks to product quality across the lifecycle.
applies_if: The question involves quality, manufacturing, or control strategy decisions that affect product quality.
example_use: Assessing impact of a manufacturing site change on product quality.

name: ICH M4 – Common Technical Document
summary: Defines format and structure of marketing authorization applications, including modules for quality, nonclinical and clinical data.
applies_if: The topic concerns how to organize or present data in a marketing application.
example_use: Preparing CTD Modules 2–5 for an EU and US submission.

name: EU MDR 2017/745 – Medical Devices Regulation
summary: Regulation defining classification rules, safety and performance requirements and oversight for medical devices and certain software in the EU.
applies_if: The product is a medical device or software with a medical purpose in the EU.
example_use: Classifying a cardiac monitoring app as an EU medical device and defining conformity route.

name: MEDDEV 2.1/6 – Borderline Products
summary: Guidance for distinguishing between medicinal products, medical devices, cosmetics and other borderline products in the EU.
applies_if: Product purpose or claims could place it in more than one regulatory category.
example_use: Determining if a skin product is a cosmetic or therapeutic device.

name: FDA SaMD Guidance – Software as a Medical Device
summary: Describes how FDA views stand-alone software functions with a medical purpose and expectations for clinical evaluation based on risk.
applies_if: Standalone software performs medical analysis, diagnosis, or treatment-related functions for US market.
example_use: AI algorithm interpreting ECG data in a US cardiology app.

name: GVP Module V – Risk Management Systems
summary: Guidance on risk management plans, safety specifications and pharmacovigilance activities in the EU.
applies_if: Topic involves post-authorisation safety, risk minimisation or pharmacovigilance planning for EU.
example_use: Updating an RMP after new safety signal emerges.

name: FDA Prescription Drug Labeling Requirements
summary: Describes content and format requirements for prescription drug labeling in the US, including indications, warnings and usage instructions.
applies_if: The question concerns US prescription drug labeling content or format.
example_use: Drafting Indications and Usage and Warnings sections for a new oncology drug.
